description: This shell script contains test cases for verifying the behavior of shallow and non-shallow cloning of git repositories with submodules, including various configurations and options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with specific conditions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks if the number of lines in the output matches the expected count.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Configures global git settings for the test environment.
